description: IRD-Dataset publishes 4,352 paved-road photographs from Baghdad collected with dashcam, drone and handheld mobile cameras. The Data in Brief article breaks them into 1,006 dashcam, 2,162 drone and 1,184 mobile images, with road-defect classes and GPS metadata. Zenodo lists public ZIP parts for images, bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation masks and locations, plus a README and YOLO configuration, under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a selected set of Baghdad paved roads. It is a labelled road-inspection collection, not a continuous condition survey of Baghdad streets or measured damage progression. Camera perspective, field selection, class prevalence and positioning precision are limitations for network-wide maintenance estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is training an observation layer that feeds pavement-state simulations. data-openstreetmap is a related base road graph, but no image-to-edge matching or model accuracy test was performed. The multi-gigabyte image archives were not downloaded.
